#Dogecoin is cryptocurrency founded in 2013 by two engineers - Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer - literally as a joke; a spoof on the boom of other rudimentary cryptocurrencies that had frequently started emerging. #Cryptocurrency #CryptoNews

#Cryptocurrencies like #Bitcoin and #Dogecoin are fungible, meaning that can be exchanged like-for-like, similar to most currencies or related financial assets. #NFTs, however, are tokens that represent unique, and one-of-a-kind objects. #BOOMExplains

Actor William Shatner of Star Trek fame sold an x-ray of his teeth from 1953 as an #NFT, while the NBA has launched #NBATopShot that sells video snippets and highlights of basketball history as NFTs. One involving #LeBronJames sold for $208,000 in March.
